description:
History is the history of war, not of words. In fact, the war that took place in this land is reconstructed in detail and majesty. In the war, you can feel the spectacle with an ink-and-wash cartoon unique to Oh-Yeon writer, such as operations and tricks, gun knife cannons, blood-sweating work, and thick dust.

**Original Webtoon:**  
Watcha, [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63090879), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10831694), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000061803), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=240074), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/10359)
